142        public static PersonAPI createMainContact(PlanetAPI ancyra) {
143                PersonAPI mainContact = ancyra.getFaction().createRandomPerson(); 
144                //mainContact.setRankId(Ranks.CITIZEN);
145                mainContact.setRankId(Ranks.SPACE_COMMANDER);
146                mainContact.setPostId(Ranks.POST_STATION_COMMANDER);
147                ancyra.getMarket().getCommDirectory().addPerson(mainContact);
148                ancyra.getMarket().addPerson(mainContact);
149                
150                return mainContact;
151        }

153        public static PersonAPI getJangalaContact() {
154                StarSystemAPI corvus = Global.getSector().getStarSystem("Corvus");
155                PlanetAPI jangala = (PlanetAPI) corvus.getEntityById("jangala");
156                
157                for (CommDirectoryEntryAPI entry : jangala.getMarket().getCommDirectory().getEntriesCopy()) {
158                        if (entry.getType() == EntryType.PERSON && entry.getEntryData() instanceof PersonAPI) {
159                                PersonAPI curr = (PersonAPI) entry.getEntryData();
160                                if (Ranks.POST_STATION_COMMANDER.equals(curr.getPostId())) {
161                                        return curr;
162                                }
163                        }
164                }
165                return null;
166        }

172        protected void updateStage(TutorialMissionStage stage, TextPanelAPI text) {
173                this.stage = stage;
174                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(TUT_STAGE, stage.name());
175                
176                if (stage != TutorialMissionStage.INIT) {
177                        //sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(stage, false);
178                        sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(stage, text);
179                }
180        }

194        protected int preRecoverFleetSize = 2;
195        
196        @Override
197        protected void advanceImpl(float amount) {
198                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
199                
200                CampaignFleetAPI player = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
201                if (player == null) return;
202                
203                //memory.advance(days);
204                elapsedDays += days;
205        
206                if (probe == null) probe = system.getEntityById("galatia_probe");
207                if (tetra == null) tetra = (PlanetAPI) system.getEntityById("tetra");
208                if (derinkuyu == null) derinkuyu = system.getEntityById("derinkuyu_station");
209                if (inner == null) inner = system.getEntityById("galatia_jump_point_alpha");
210                if (fringe == null) fringe = system.getEntityById("galatia_jump_point_fringe");
211                if (detachment == null) detachment = system.getEntityById("tutorial_security_detachment");
212                
213                if (stage == TutorialMissionStage.GO_GET_AI_CORE) {
214                        int cores = (int) player.getCargo().getCommodityQuantity(Commodities.GAMMA_CORE);
215                        float distToProbe = Misc.getDistance(player.getLocation(), probe.getLocation());
216                        if (cores > 0 && (!probe.isAlive() || distToProbe < 300)) {
217//                              Global.getSector().reportEventStage(this, "salvage_core_end", Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet(),
218//                                              MessagePriority.DELIVER_IMMEDIATELY, createSetMessageLocationScript(ancyra));
219                                Misc.makeImportant(mainContact, REASON);
220                                updateStage(TutorialMissionStage.GOT_AI_CORE, null);
221                        }
222                }
223                
224                if (stage == TutorialMissionStage.GO_RECOVER_SHIPS) {
225                        int count = 0;
226                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : player.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
227                                //if (member.getVariant().getHullSpec().isDHull()) count++;
228                                count++;
229                        }
230                        
231                        int wrecks = 0;
232                        for (SectorEntityToken entity : system.getEntitiesWithTag(Tags.SALVAGEABLE)) {
233                                String id = entity.getCustomEntityType();
234                                if (id == null) continue;
235                                if (Entities.WRECK.equals(id)) {
236                                        wrecks ++;
237                                }
238                        }
239                        
240                        if (count >= preRecoverFleetSize + 2 || wrecks < 3) {
241//                              Global.getSector().reportEventStage(this, "ship_recovery_end", Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet(),
242//                                                      MessagePriority.DELIVER_IMMEDIATELY, createSetMessageLocationScript(ancyra));
243                                Misc.makeImportant(mainContact, REASON);
244                                Misc.makeUnimportant(tetra, REASON);
245                                updateStage(TutorialMissionStage.RECOVERED_SHIPS, null);
246                        }
247                }
248                
249                if (stage == TutorialMissionStage.GO_STABILIZE) {
250                        boolean innerStable = inner.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getExpire(JumpPointInteractionDialogPluginImpl.UNSTABLE_KEY) > 0;
251                        boolean fringeStable = fringe.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getExpire(JumpPointInteractionDialogPluginImpl.UNSTABLE_KEY) > 0;
252                        
253                        if (innerStable || fringeStable) {
254//                              Global.getSector().reportEventStage(this, "stabilize_jump_point_done", Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet(),
255//                                              MessagePriority.DELIVER_IMMEDIATELY, createSetMessageLocationScript(ancyra));
256                                Misc.makeImportant(mainContact, REASON);
257                                Misc.makeUnimportant(inner, REASON);
258                                updateStage(TutorialMissionStage.STABILIZED, null);
259                        }
260                        
261                }
262        
263        }

265        @Override
266        public boolean callEvent(String ruleId, final InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
267                String action = params.get(0).getString(memoryMap);
268                
269                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
270                CargoAPI cargo = playerFleet.getCargo();
271                
272                TextPanelAPI text = null;
273                if (dialog != null) text = dialog.getTextPanel();
274                
275                if (action.equals("startGetData")) {
276//                      Global.getSector().reportEventStage(this, "sneak_start", Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet(),
277//                                      MessagePriority.DELIVER_IMMEDIATELY, createSetMessageLocationScript(derinkuyu));
278                        
279                        dataContact.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$tut_dataContact", true);
280                        dataContact.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$tut_eventRef", this);
281                        Misc.makeImportant(dataContact, REASON);
282                        Misc.makeUnimportant(mainContact, REASON);
283                        
284                        detachment.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PATROL_ALLOW_TOFF, true);
285                        
286                        updateStage(TutorialMissionStage.GO_GET_DATA, text);
287                        
288                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$tutMadeContactAtAncyra", true);
289                        
290                        saveNag();
291                } else if (action.equals("endGetData")) {
292                        
293//                      Global.getSector().reportEventStage(this, "sneak_end", Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet(),
294//                                      MessagePriority.DELIVER_IMMEDIATELY, createSetMessageLocationScript(ancyra));
295                        Misc.cleanUpMissionMemory(dataContact.getMemoryWithoutUpdate(), "tut_");
296                        
297                        Misc.makeUnimportant(dataContact, REASON);
298                        Misc.makeImportant(mainContact, REASON);
299                        
300                        updateStage(TutorialMissionStage.GOT_DATA, text);
301                        
302                } else if (action.equals("goSalvage")) {
303//                      Global.getSector().reportEventStage(this, "salvage_core_start", Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet(),
304//                                      MessagePriority.DELIVER_IMMEDIATELY, createSetMessageLocationScript(pontus));
305                        Misc.makeUnimportant(mainContact, REASON);
306                        Misc.makeImportant(probe, REASON);
307                        
308                        updateStage(TutorialMissionStage.GO_GET_AI_CORE, text);
309                        
310                        saveNag();
311                } else if (action.equals("goRecover")) {
312//                      Global.getSector().reportEventStage(this, "ship_recovery_start", Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet(),
313//                                      MessagePriority.DELIVER_IMMEDIATELY, createSetMessageLocationScript(tetra));
314                        Misc.makeUnimportant(mainContact, REASON);
315                        Misc.makeImportant(tetra, REASON);
316                        
317                        FleetMemberAPI member = Global.getFactory().createFleetMember(FleetMemberType.SHIP, "mudskipper_Standard");
318                        playerFleet.getFleetData().addFleetMember(member);
319                        AddRemoveCommodity.addFleetMemberGainText(member, dialog.getTextPanel());
320                        
321                        preRecoverFleetSize = playerFleet.getFleetData().getNumMembers();
322                        
323                        updateStage(TutorialMissionStage.GO_RECOVER_SHIPS, text);
324                } else if (action.equals("goStabilize")) {
325//                      Global.getSector().reportEventStage(this, "stabilize_jump_point", Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet(),
326//                                      MessagePriority.DELIVER_IMMEDIATELY, createSetMessageLocationScript(inner));
327                        Misc.makeUnimportant(mainContact, REASON);
328                        Misc.makeImportant(inner, REASON);
329
330                        addWeaponsToStorage();
331                        
332                        inner.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(JumpPointInteractionDialogPluginImpl.CAN_STABILIZE, true);
333                        fringe.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(JumpPointInteractionDialogPluginImpl.CAN_STABILIZE, true);
334                        
335                        updateStage(TutorialMissionStage.GO_STABILIZE, text);
336                        
337                        saveNag();
338//              } else if (action.equals("addStipend")) {
339                } else if (action.equals("pickJangalaContact")) {
340                        
341                        StarSystemAPI corvus = Global.getSector().getStarSystem("Corvus");
342                        jangala = (PlanetAPI) corvus.getEntityById("jangala");
343                        
344                        jangalaContact = getJangalaContact();
345                        
346                        MemoryAPI mem = mainContact.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
347                        mem.set("$jangalaContactPost", jangalaContact.getPost().toLowerCase(), 0);
348                        mem.set("$jangalaContactLastName", jangalaContact.getName().getLast(), 0);
349
350                        float distLY = Misc.getDistanceLY(playerFleet.getLocationInHyperspace(), jangala.getLocationInHyperspace());
351                        distLY += 4f;
352
353                        float fuel = playerFleet.getLogistics().getFuelCostPerLightYear() * distLY;
354                        fuel = (float) (Math.ceil(fuel / 10) * 10);
355                        mem.set("$jangalaFuel", (int) fuel);
356                } else if (action.equals("deliverReport")) {
357//                      Global.getSector().reportEventStage(this, "deliver_message", Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet(),
358//                                                                      MessagePriority.DELIVER_IMMEDIATELY, createSetMessageLocationScript(jangala));
359                        
360                        Misc.makeUnimportant(mainContact, REASON);
361                        Misc.cleanUpMissionMemory(mainContact.getMemoryWithoutUpdate(), REASON + "_");
362                        Misc.makeUnimportant(inner, REASON);
363                        
364                        jangalaContact.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$tut_jangalaContact", true);
365                        jangalaContact.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$tut_eventRef", this);
366                        Misc.makeImportant(jangalaContact, REASON);
367                        
368                        updateStage(TutorialMissionStage.DELIVER_REPORT, text);
369                        
370                        endGalatiaPortionOfMission(true, true);
371                        
372                        Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(CampaignTutorialScript.USE_TUTORIAL_RESPAWN);
373                        
374                } else if (action.equals("reportDelivered")) {
375//                      Global.getSector().reportEventStage(this, "end", Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet(),
376//                                      MessagePriority.DELIVER_IMMEDIATELY, createSetMessageLocationScript(jangala));
377                        
378                        Misc.makeUnimportant(jangalaContact, REASON);
379                        Misc.cleanUpMissionMemory(jangalaContact.getMemoryWithoutUpdate(), REASON + "_");
380                        
381                        updateStage(TutorialMissionStage.DONE, text);
382                        
383                        MarketAPI jangala = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("jangala");
384                        
385                        if (jangala != null) {
386                                SystemBountyManager.getInstance().addOrResetBounty(jangala);
387                        }
388                        
389                        endEvent();
390                } else if (action.equals("doRepairs")) {
391                        for (FleetMemberAPI member : playerFleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
392                                member.getRepairTracker().setMothballed(false);
393                                member.getStatus().repairFully();
394                                float max = member.getRepairTracker().getMaxCR();
395                                max = Math.max(max, .7f);
396                                float curr = member.getRepairTracker().getBaseCR();
397                                if (max > curr) {
398                                        member.getRepairTracker().applyCREvent(max - curr, "Repaired at dockyard");
399                                }
400                        }
401                } else if (action.equals("printRefitHint")) {
402                        String refit = Global.getSettings().getControlStringForEnumName("CORE_REFIT");
403                        String autofit = Global.getSettings().getControlStringForEnumName("REFIT_MANAGE_VARIANTS");
404                        String transponder = "";
405                        if (!playerFleet.isTransponderOn()) {
406                                transponder = "\n\nAlso: you'll need to re-dock with your transponder turned on to take advantage of Ancyra's facilities.";
407                        }
408                        dialog.getTextPanel().addPara("(Once this conversation is over, press %s to open the refit screen. " +
409                                        "After selecting a specific ship, you can press %s to %s - pick a desired loadout, " +
410                                        "and the ship will be automatically refitted to match it, using what weapons are available." + 
411                                        transponder + "",
412                                        Misc.getHighlightColor(), refit, autofit, "\"autofit\"");
413                        
414                        dialog.getTextPanel().addPara("In addition, you now have access to local storage at Ancyra, " +
415                                        "and some weapons and supplies have been placed there. To access it, click on the " +
416                                        "\"Storage\" button in the trade screen.)",
417                                        Misc.getHighlightColor(), refit, autofit, "\"Storage\"");
418                }
419                
420                return true;
421        }

423        public static void endGalatiaPortionOfMission(boolean withStipend, boolean didTutorial) {
424        
425                if (withStipend) {
426                        new GalatianAcademyStipend();
427                }
428                
429                StarSystemAPI system = Global.getSector().getStarSystem("galatia");
430                PlanetAPI ancyra = (PlanetAPI) system.getEntityById("ancyra");
431                PlanetAPI pontus = (PlanetAPI) system.getEntityById("pontus");
432                PlanetAPI tetra = (PlanetAPI) system.getEntityById("tetra");
433                SectorEntityToken derinkuyu = system.getEntityById("derinkuyu_station");
434                SectorEntityToken probe = system.getEntityById("galatia_probe");
435                SectorEntityToken inner = system.getEntityById("galatia_jump_point_alpha");
436                SectorEntityToken fringe = system.getEntityById("galatia_jump_point_fringe");
437                SectorEntityToken relay = system.getEntityById("ancyra_relay");
438                
439                relay.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(MemFlags.OBJECTIVE_NON_FUNCTIONAL);
440                
441                Global.getSector().getCharacterData().addAbility(Abilities.TRANSPONDER);
442                Global.getSector().getCharacterData().addAbility(Abilities.GO_DARK);
443                Global.getSector().getCharacterData().addAbility(Abilities.SENSOR_BURST);
444                Global.getSector().getCharacterData().addAbility(Abilities.EMERGENCY_BURN);
445                Global.getSector().getCharacterData().addAbility(Abilities.SUSTAINED_BURN);
446                Global.getSector().getCharacterData().addAbility(Abilities.SCAVENGE);
447                Global.getSector().getCharacterData().addAbility(Abilities.INTERDICTION_PULSE);
448                Global.getSector().getCharacterData().addAbility(Abilities.DISTRESS_CALL);
449                
450                FactionAPI hegemony = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.HEGEMONY);
451                if (hegemony.getRelToPlayer().getRel() < 0) {
452                        hegemony.getRelToPlayer().setRel(0);
453                }
454                
455                // removing this leaves "supplement from local resources" bonuses active
456                //ancyra.getMarket().removeSubmarket(Submarkets.LOCAL_RESOURCES);
457                
458                Global.getSector().getEconomy().addMarket(ancyra.getMarket(), false);
459                Global.getSector().getEconomy().addMarket(derinkuyu.getMarket(), false);
460                
461                HintPanelAPI hints = Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().getHintPanel();
462                if (hints != null) {
463                        hints.clearHints(false);
464                }
465                
466                if (!Misc.isExtended()) {
467                        if (!SystemBountyManager.getInstance().isActive(ancyra.getMarket())) {
468                                SystemBountyManager.getInstance().addActive(new SystemBountyIntel(ancyra.getMarket()));
469                        }
470                }
471//              CampaignEventManagerAPI eventManager = Global.getSector().getEventManager();
472//              eventManager.startEvent(new CampaignEventTarget(ancyra.getMarket()), Events.SYSTEM_BOUNTY, null);
473                
474                RogueMinerMiscFleetManager script = new RogueMinerMiscFleetManager(derinkuyu);
475                for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
476                        script.advance(1f);
477                }
478                system.addScript(script);
479                
480                for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : system.getFleets()) {
481                        if (Factions.PIRATES.equals(fleet.getFaction().getId())) {
482                                fleet.removeScriptsOfClass(TutorialLeashAssignmentAI.class);
483                        }
484                }
485                
486                inner.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(JumpPointInteractionDialogPluginImpl.UNSTABLE_KEY);
487                inner.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(JumpPointInteractionDialogPluginImpl.CAN_STABILIZE);
488                
489                fringe.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(JumpPointInteractionDialogPluginImpl.UNSTABLE_KEY);
490                fringe.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(JumpPointInteractionDialogPluginImpl.CAN_STABILIZE);
491                
492                system.removeTag(Tags.SYSTEM_CUT_OFF_FROM_HYPER);
493                
494                MarketAPI market = ancyra.getMarket();
495                market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(MemFlags.MARKET_DO_NOT_INIT_COMM_LISTINGS);
496                market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.PATROL_NUM_LIGHT_MOD).unmodifyMult("tut");
497                market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.PATROL_NUM_MEDIUM_MOD).unmodifyMult("tut");
498                market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.PATROL_NUM_HEAVY_MOD).unmodifyMult("tut");
499                market.setEconGroup(null);
500                
501                derinkuyu.getMarket().setEconGroup(null);
502                
503//              if (didTutorial) {
504//                      Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$sti");
505//              }
506        }

547        public String getWeaponForSlot(WeaponSlotAPI slot) {
548                switch (slot.getWeaponType()) {
549                case BALLISTIC:
550                case COMPOSITE:
551                case HYBRID:
552                case UNIVERSAL:
553                        switch (slot.getSlotSize()) {
554                        case LARGE: return pick("mark9", "hephag", "hellbore");
555                        case MEDIUM: return pick("arbalest", "heavymortar", "shredder");
556                        case SMALL: return pick("lightmg", "lightac", "lightmortar");
557                        }
558                        break;
559                case MISSILE:
560                case SYNERGY:
561                        switch (slot.getSlotSize()) {
562                        case LARGE: return pick("hammerrack");
563                        case MEDIUM: return pick("pilum", "annihilatorpod");
564                        case SMALL: return pick("harpoon", "sabot", "annihilator");
565                        }
566                        break;
567                case ENERGY:
568                        switch (slot.getSlotSize()) {
569                        case LARGE: return pick("autopulse", "hil");
570                        case MEDIUM: return pick("miningblaster", "gravitonbeam", "pulselaser");
571                        case SMALL: return pick("mininglaser", "taclaser", "pdlaser", "ioncannon");
572                        }
573                        break;
574                }
575                
576        
577                return null;
578        }

587                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
588                Color c = getTitleColor(mode);

590                float pad = 3f;
591                float opad = 10f;

599                
600        protected void addBulletPoints(TooltipMakerAPI info, ListInfoMode mode) {
601                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
602                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
603                Color c = getTitleColor(mode);
604                
605                float opad = 10f;
606                
607                float pad = 3f;
608                if (mode == ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) pad = 10f;
609                
610                Color tc = getBulletColorForMode(mode);
611                
612                bullet(info);
613                
614                switch (stage) {
615                case INIT:
616                        info.addPara("Contact " + getMainContactPostName() + " at Ancyra", tc, pad);
617                        break;
618                case GO_GET_DATA:
619                        info.addPara("Sneak into " + derinkuyu.getName(), tc, pad);
620                        info.addPara("Contact " + dataContact.getNameString() + " and retrieve data", tc, 0f);
621                        break;
622                case GOT_DATA:
623                        info.addPara("Deliver data to " + getMainContactPostName() + " at Ancyra", tc, pad);
624                        break;
625                case GO_GET_AI_CORE:
626                        info.addPara("Retrieve AI core from derelict probe beyond the orbit of Pontus", tc, pad);
627                        break;
628                case GOT_AI_CORE:
629                        info.addPara("Deliver AI core to " + getMainContactPostName() + " at Ancyra", tc, pad);
630                        break;
631                case GO_RECOVER_SHIPS:
632                        info.addPara("Recover at least %s ships at Tetra", pad, tc, h, "" + 2);
633                        break;
634                case RECOVERED_SHIPS:
635                        info.addPara("Return to " + getMainContactPostName() + " with the ships", tc, pad);
636                        break;
637                case GO_STABILIZE:
638                        info.addPara("Stabilize the inner-system jump-point", tc, pad);
639                        break;
640                case STABILIZED:
641                        info.addPara("Return to Ancyra and report your success", tc, pad);
642                        break;
643                case DELIVER_REPORT:
644                        info.addPara("Deliver report to " + getJangalaContactPostName() + " at Jangala", tc, pad);
645                        break;
646                case DONE:
647                        info.addPara("Completed", tc, pad);
648                        break;
649                }
650                
651                unindent(info);
652        }

675        public void createSmallDescription(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
676                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
677                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
678                Color tc = Misc.getTextColor();
679                float pad = 3f;
680                float opad = 10f;
681                
682                //info.addImage(dataContact.getFaction().getLogo(), width, 256 / 1.6f, opad);
683
684                boolean addedBullets = false;
685                switch (stage) {
686                case INIT:
687                        info.addPara("You receive a tight-beam communication from the system's main inhabited world, Ancyra.", opad);
688                        
689                        info.addPara("The message is brief and asks you to travel there and contact " +
690                                                 getMainContactPostName() + " as soon as possible.", opad);
691                        break;
692                case GO_GET_DATA:
693                        info.addPara("Contact " + dataContact.getNameString() + " at Derinkuyu Mining Station " +
694                                        "to acquire the raw jump-point readings.", opad);
695                        
696                        info.addPara("Contact must be made with the transponder off as the miners of Derinkuyu have " +
697                                        "turned pirate and your fleet will be attacked otherwise.", opad);
698
699//                      addBulletPoints(info, true, tc);
700//                      addedBullets = true;
701                        
702                        info.addPara("Use %s to avoid detection, and %s to get away if you are seen.", opad, h,
703                                        "Go Dark", "Emergency Burn");
704                        break;
705                case GOT_DATA:
706                        info.addPara("Return to Ancyra and contact " + getMainContactPostName() + 
707                                                 " to deliver the jump-point data.", opad);
708                        break;
709                case GO_GET_AI_CORE:
710                        info.addPara("Analyzing the jump-point data requires an AI Core.", opad);
711
712                        info.addPara("There's a Domain-era survey probe outside the orbit of Pontus. If salvaged, " +
713                                                 "it's likely to yield a gamma AI core, which should be sufficient for the task.", opad);
714                        
715                        info.addPara("Go to Pontus, head out towards the asteroid belt, and then use an " +
716                                                 "%s to locate the probe. ", opad, h, "Active Sensor Burst");
717
718                        info.addPara("Approach the probe and salvage it to recover the gamma core.", opad);
719
720                        info.addPara("It's likely that you will have to overcome some automated defenses first.", opad);
721                        break;
722                case GOT_AI_CORE:
723                        info.addPara("Return to Ancyra and contact " + getMainContactPostName() + 
724                                                 " to deliver the AI core.", opad);
725                        break;
726                case GO_RECOVER_SHIPS:
727                        info.addPara("Go to the ship graveyard around Tetra and recover as many ships as possible.", opad);
728
729                        info.addPara("Bring extra crew to man the recovered ships, and extra supplies to " +
730                                                 " help restore their combat readiness.", opad);
731                        break;
732                case RECOVERED_SHIPS:
733                        info.addPara("Return to " + getMainContactPostName() + 
734                                                 " at Ancyra for help with outfitting the recovered ships with weapons.", opad);
735                        break;
736                case GO_STABILIZE:
737                        info.addPara("Use the hyperwave sequence produced by the AI core " +
738                                        "to stabilize the inner-system jump-point.", opad);
739
740                        info.addPara("You will have to defeat the pirates guarding it first.", opad);
741                        break;
742                case STABILIZED:
743                        info.addPara("Galatia's connection with hyperspace has been restored, " +
744                                        "and trade fleets are once again able to enter and leave the system.", opad);
745
746                        info.addPara("The Derinkuyu leadership will surely soon be toppled by rank-and-file " +
747                                                 "miners eager to get on the right side of the law once again.", opad);
748                        break;
749                case DELIVER_REPORT:
750                        info.addPara(Misc.ucFirst(getMainContactPostName()) + " has tasked you with delivering a report " +
751                                        "detailing the recent events to the " + getJangalaContactPostName() + " at Jangala.", opad);
752
753                        info.addPara("Make sure you have enough fuel to make the trip successfully.", opad);
754                        break;

758                        
759                        info.addPara("Galatia's connection with hyperspace has been restored, " +
760                                                 "and trade fleets are once again able to enter and leave the system.", opad);
761                        break;
762                }
763                
764//              if (!addedBullets) {

766//              }
767
